retained_native_rule.interpretation: Preserve the original provider rating and its selected surface-layer rule. An authored component/depth projection is a separate source edition. Organic or absent horizon values are retained as unknown.

sources.title: Fundamental Query
sources.purpose: Source keys, left joins, survey vintage
sources.notes: Survey→legend→mapunit→component→horizon. Record native mukey/cokey/chkey and source saversion/saverest; missing children remain in the selected mapunit population.

sources.title: Soil Data Viewer 6.2 User Guide
sources.notes: Surface-layer selection differs from depth aggregation; dominant condition differs from dominant component. Weighted means use component percentages and, when chosen, overlapping horizon thickness. Missing-value treatment and retained coverage must accompany any numerical projection. In an equal null/non-null tie, the native Viewer selects non-null. The authored strict policy is separately conservative; selected lower/higher controls resolve the remaining known candidates.

sources.title: SSURGO 2.3.2 Table Column Descriptions
sources.notes: Kw reflects rock fragments; Kf remains a different attribute. Component low/representative/high columns describe component proportions; horizon depth fields describe boundaries.

sources.title: SSURGO 2.3.2 Tables and Columns
sources.notes: Kw and Kf are Choice columns in the soil_erodibility_factor domain. Original choice text is retained before any Decimal projection.

sources.title: Soil Data Access Query Guide
sources.sections: Source entities, versioning and high/low/representative values
sources.notes: Mapped component data describe an aggregate soil population. The source keys and tabular composition do not locate each component within a raster pixel.

sources.title: InVEST 3.20.0 SDR model documentation
sources.notes: Required SI K is t·ha·h/(ha·MJ·mm); convert customary K by 0.1317 once. The original prepared source already declares SI. A new source's sediment response is computed in a distinct actual SDR case; its K comparison alone does not supply that response.

implementation_decisions: Keep the original provider Dominant Condition/Surface Layer result as its own unchanged baseline.
Use selected physical mapunit keys and matched survey versions. A later source vintage creates a distinct capture and cannot be labelled the original survey.
Capture complete source rows and original HTTP responses before projecting numeric values.
Retain absent parent/child relations, null Choice values, component percentage coverage and horizon gaps/overlap.
Every chosen depth/major-component/missing-value projection is an explicit saved analyst selection.
Do not infer component subpixel locations or statistical confidence intervals from component percentages.
Do not apply the customary-to-SI factor twice or substitute Kf for missing Kw.
Store changes through the existing source, grid, model case and workspace archive workflow.

Dominant candidates are selected before rating availability; missing strictly greater dominant weight stays missing. Equal null/non-null ties follow USDA's non-null preference and expose all tied source component IDs.

Use the existing Source Preparation soil-components and soil-component-scenario methods; table output is available without a reference grid, raster model use requires explicit model selection and an analyst note.

Verify either the complete original regional capture or the named SC007 interpretation reference with its exact native CSV, method, full 49-member archive and original ratings/legend. Reference-only evidence supports complete table/report comparisons and cannot provide raster geometry.
Retain current full Kw/Kf Choice metadata and original HTTP body alongside the five complete relation tables.
Open the exact saved HTML through authenticated report/companion tickets; rewrite links only in the static display, preserving complete original download bytes.
